They have served different biryanis. But I like the noodle. One thing special I can said is the shrimp curry. It is interesting. 

Overall the price is at the high side. I do not get the wow factor. But I can tell you they don't make it less spicy because of Americans. They did spicy the food which suppose to be. I would give them 3.5 star f

I have book mark Honu for some time. Honu is Hawaiian Green Sea Turtle which is remarkable creature. They have plenty of the decoration about this type of turtle at their wall. Those are cute turtle picture on display. 

We were there New Year eve and they are the only few still have space for 6:30 sitting. We were plan to eat there and go to the New Year show. We start with the Musubi - sautéed spam in seaweed and rice. Very interesting. The second dish is the special of the day with salmon poke and thin piece rice cake. This is interesting dish too. We have the stack - slow cook pork on sushi rice top with claw slaw. The rice is not my liking. The pork are sweet. The final dish Mauna Kea Keck II - slow cook beef on the spinach with twin scoop of rice. The beef is average. The rice definite needs improvement. 

Overall the service is very good. The dishes presentation are well design. However the food seasoning and taste is not there. I like the live music and dollar champagne for good New Year celebration.

This restaurant located in the Hilton Garden Inn near airport. This is interesting to see a restaurant in the hotel. We were here for lunch. The food is not cheap for lunch and dinner after we look at the menu. As long they can provide a good food. We are good. 

We order the chicken panini and the Margherita Classic. The panini is good. Chicken was grilled. Accompanied fries was crispy. The Margherita is a flatbread top with chop steak with mozzarella cheese. It very good. Overall the food is good. The wait is a bit longer for the food. 

The reason is three stars is due to waiter didn't pay attention to the table. Even we try to flag him down. Lunch during office hour usually is short. They need to paid attention we try to paid and get put. It take us ten minutes to finally get his attention.

I have a late lunch here. I walk into the restaurant at 2:20 pm and they have two table occupied. I was sit immediately. 

The furniture is a bit old. The table is a bit sticky. The waiters were nice and courteous. I got the steak taco with rice combo. It is $9.95. The food came out in 10 minutes. The tortilla is a 8 inches flour tortillas. It is big and they have to stick the tortilla with toothpick. The steak is regular steak nothing fancy. No special cut section. It is definite good with fill up you stomach. They guacamole, cheese and salsa for the add on. 

The rice is nicely cook and typically prepared. Before the meal come, they provide the chip and salsa. The salsa came in a small dish. It is easily finish with less than 10 scoops. I have to ask for more. 

Overall is not the five star restaurant. Service is good. It is done that check off deal.

If you looking for meat, they have deal in the store. I got beef flank steak only for $4.95 a pound for the special of the day. It has many types of beef and pork cut. 

The meat market serves hot deli such as empanadas, tacos, fried chicken and more. The price of those deli food are affordable. It has package deal. For is ok since the price is low no complaints. They do have the seating area if you decide to eat there. 

The veggies section just like normal supermarket and same as the can good and un perishable food. They do have special soft drinks. Some from drink still at original bottle packaging. 

This store just like typical supermarket but is local own. The advantage is the meat they have sold here. If you have huge party at your home and hosting a BBQ, this is a good place to purchase your meat.

GUAC has a good thing go with it. They just need to have more customers. The time we have visited was Saturday evening. It is half fill with customers during our visit. 

We were here for the Taco Week. At the bar, there are two person man the station. One paid attention to what we need and the other just not engaging. I am glad at lease the one not take our order still paid attention to us. 

I would said the quality of the ingredients is there. We got the shrimp, steak and specialty shrimp taco.  As I said good quality of the steak and shrimp. But need salt on the meat and shrimp. The shrimp was blackened, but the taste is not there. I think the restaurant has potential. Price is about right. But the food need to savory.

I think the rating here is a bit overrated. I think their poke is at the middle in comparison with the poke stores in Tampa Bay Area. This restaurant has some good thing and not so good thing. 

Let begin what they do well. The protein selection are excellent. This is the item they do very well. Their protein included Tuna, Salmon and especially the Scallops. Their scallops are sea scallops with giant size scallops. Do you know Tarpon Springs has scalloping your. The shrimp is cooked with seasoning and very nice. Other worthy mention is the octopus protein. 

Now, the bad side. The base. The rice is too soft and not hard enough. Like old people food. Seem like too much water to use for cooking the rice. The sushi rice not really taste like sushi rice preparation. Very limited of the mixed in. Second. They only allow number of choice for mixed in. Compare to other place, many offer unlimited selection. Third. The sauce like ponzu, soy sauce, eel sauce all are too watery. Fourth, I can see when they pick up the mixed in, the water from the mixed in containers are drip into your poke. 

One thing for sure, their poke is fresh enough.

It very convenient too have a rest area before the long bridge. It not just to provide the facilities but also have great view to the bay. This south end facility is a lot more beautiful view than the one on the north. It curve into east to allow a great view to the sunshine Skyway Bridge. 

However, the restroom is now t the best in the area. It is a bit dirty. It has the picnic area in the area. The parking is the best view to the bay. The exit connects to the old sunshine Skyway Bridge and now is the fishing pier.

I am exited Pena open their fast food store in the Amateurwork. I look at the menu and select the most expensive in the menu. The Mediterranean Salad. This salad has prosciutto, hummus, tomatoes, arugula, little bok Choy, and bread. If I count the prosciutto and the veggies they kind not measure up to the price. But I do like their medjool dates and the marcona nut. The salad just ok not impressive. 

I did see my friend post on the sandwich is better. I would not recommend the salad. Just go for sandwiches, they are better.

Sushi burrito is new thing in the recent food world. Basically is poke in a wrap. This handheld is new to people as comfort food. It has good attraction to many people try to catch the trend. I am also one of them. 

I got the original sushi burrito. It has tuna, tempura shrimp, asparagus and more. You can choose the sauce. It is wrap with very soft skin eatable wrap. This burrito to me is like something you need it quick. It look like blue color lunch but cannot be made for hours wait and eat due to raw fish. 

I also got durian boba. The cup indicated Ha Long Bay. I am guessing this restaurant is relate to the Ha Long Bay restaurant. Not much of service. Basically order at counter and wait for your food.

Ava is well decorated to match the younger generation. I like the decorations. However I don't like chair with cross vinyl support seat cushion. I like the bar area is well lid in color. This restaurant is selling atmosphere. 

We have ordered the seared duck breast and the spaghetti e vongole. The duck breast is with the cherry sauce on top of the pistachio goat cheese. The combination is ok if you like goat cheese. It will better with grilled veggies. The spaghetti e vongole is spaghetti with little neck clam. It is white wine sauce. I have this dish at elsewhere. The current experience is not top that previous experience. The wine sauce can be better. 

I can see that why they are not above average. The portion of the food is small compared to many restaurant. It is almost need additional food after we have finished eating. Value is not there and the taste not measure up to the price is charge.

If you need a tow truck while you can wait, this may be your option. We have to tow one of my car. We call the tow center and they responded immediately to the call. Very detail ask what type of car we have. It is to know your car is front wheel drive and the back of the tire is flat. This information eventually save you a trip for wrong tow truck. When you have that situation, the lift and two wheels tow will not work. Because they have to tow from the back due to your bad tire cannot contact the ground to protect from damages to the car rim. But the front wheel drive prevents the tow from the back not to dame the engine. Only way is use the flat bed tow truck. This is important to know which tow truck to use. 

I would give them a higher star if they on time. The promise time was delay 2 hours. You don't want call other tow company because by the time you call them, the wait will be the same.

The items I like about this gas station including wide driveway between gas pump. It allow easy access to to pump and leaving as well. It also has 16 gas pumps which make the empty pump availability is higher. 

This gas station has two security camera facing the pumps. This security feature help the safe environment for the customers. The main building has dunkin donut which make more customers to visit.

I only been to cinema twice a year since the the DVDs are so convenient. I only gone to movie if I feel it is worthy to be on big screen or group of friend want to do it. 

During the Christmas Day first show usually is the best while many people are just wait up and open the gift. Not too many of people in the seat and there is plenty of selection where you want to seat. We are watching the stars war 3D movie with good technology. I can see now the movie making is in the 4K technology. This is very nice. The 3D glass also improved and easy to wear and no headache. 

I cannot believe this cinema is now belong to carmike group since my last visit. There is no pre commercial before the schedule showing. Everything commercial or preview is after the schedule time in the ticket. Which wastes at least 20 minutes before the feature movie. 

The popcorn and drink is pricy mark up. Seat is ok but they need to lubricate the squeaking sound of the rocking chair.

See's candies is California base bakery reach Florida. I know about this candies when my wife living in California. Their chocolate is very soft and tasty. 

In Tampa, the International Plaza Mall has this temporary store from Thanksgiving to Easter. They located very close to H&M clothing store. You can have samples before you buy it. I got the lollipop candies. I also bought one assorted chocolate candies. They are very good. The store clerk was kind enough to let us try their assorted chocolate other their typical sample candies. 

You can go with chocolate with nut, mint, toffee, milk, white or dark chocolate. All are good. Guilty pleasure with a touch at sweet side. Mail order through the web also available. If you close to the mall, just go to buy one without shipping.

I could not find a pelican there today. At least not the rusty pelican. But if I sit long enough and I will become one since the view is nice and make you feel relax and still. I can be one. 

This water front property has the killer bay view for the people who dine there. I would said it has nice sunset view. Price range is at high side for the food. The interior is well decorated. The dinning hall has the bay view. They have ball room can easily fit 200 people with bay east view. 

I was here for a society meeting. We was done in this ballroom that is beautiful for wedding. Our entrée is not in the regular menu. It is shell pasta with stuff cheese in side. It accompanied with green beans and carrots. The food is good. This place is good with seafood and steak. 

The service is good and attentive. Overall the welcoming host and restaurant do a good job.

The tire plus here is better than the one at new tampa. They are performed the tire change, balance, rotation or alignment better. I have come to here for my tire replacement.  I always find a 40,000 mile warranty tire here and change them almost every two year or more since tire do not last. What is the point to buy the good tire. The tire may be miss alignment once you hit the curb unintentionally. 

They tire plus here have the life time alignment and balance if you buy the tire here. I already got my money worth since I have been here for more than tree time due to their life time program.  I suggest you do the same. Right now they have the tire in 59 minutes or you are free program if you make appointment. A smart way to come here is to make appointment and there is less wait. 

They have wifi if you want to bring your computer while you wait for your car. Other than oil change, tire, and tune up please go to your dealer.

The new remodel Gator Dockside looks a lot better than the old one. They have change the carpet floor to wood floor look more elegant. From the old projected TV to digital large screen TV. The renovation is welcoming the patron to the new football season. 

I like to come to this restaurant mainly is their chicken wings. First, select the way you want it - Grill, breaded, wet sauce, or boneless. Second, select number of wings. Third, select the flavor. Tonight we have tried 12 different flavors. My top three I like most are grill chipotle BBQ, grill Thai chili, and the grill Yucatan. If you dare, try their 4 alam wings. This wing is super hot that one of our friends tries it and burn the mouth. I also like the peanut butter flavor with unique taste. 

This sport bar is family oriented bar. Many families bring their kids. They have the children menu. The restaurant service is good and the food came out fast with 100 wings.

Cafe style. I have the take out all the time. This place have all kind Spanish food from fried whole fish to teriyaki chicken. They gave selection of small or big plate. Range from $4 to $6.50. 

They also have devil crab, chicken or ground beef empanadas, stuff potato. They also have freshly make Cuban sandwich. 

Compare to fast food change, cafeteria style is a better option. I always come here for for the guarapole ( sugar cane juice). They prepare the fresh squeeze on the site. It is good. 

Please be aware the lunch crowd build up after 11:30 am. Please come early. If you come after 11:30 am, the line is already to the door. Friday night, music and fun is happen here. People gather after work for music.

Very establish bar. Every weekend is party at the front porch. People are gathering on the outside and have a good time with a boo. Independent has it character of the neighborhood bar. Very lively there. 

We were there for the Nate Najar Quartet jazz music. This jazz team is well known in the Bay Area. Our share table has some people from St. Pete came here just for this night. This bar has many musicians performed here before. This is my first time to Independent and I like it due to their crazy bar tender. Nothing better to sat at the bar and see all the drink fly out from the bar. Sometimes you can chat to your neighbor and enjoy the music. I like it not too loud but the music is still can be appreciated. 

They have some of bar food and good selection of local draft beers. I like it they post the percentage of the content of alcohol. You can know your limits when you order it if you have to drive home.

Holiday shopping has big sale. The entire store with 25 % discount with purchase. The Black Friday sale make a lot people happy. It include me. It is huge with 25% of savings and back to the pocket. Although is Mc Donald value meal saving for each pair of shoes, I am happy too. 

I got a pair of Nike Air Visi pro VI. It is very lightweight. It is only 2.4 lbs light weight basketball shoe. I always choose basketball shoes to prevent roll of ankle. This show normally run $56 to $150. But I got mark down and 25% off. I end up paid only $40. 

The checkout line is long when they have good sales. I may be number 30 in the line. However they open two additional remote registers in additional to 6 registers they already have. I check out in 8 minutes. Customers care is great with long line.

My go to Walmart. It has most of the thing I need in great price. I like this Walmart in three different way. Grocery, daily use, and pharmacy. This is a super Walmart. So it has more items than regular Walmart. 

Start with grocery. They have bakery, fresh produce, deli, meat and seafood, frozen section and many more. Price is acceptable. I like the Parmesan chicken wing. This is my favorite in the deli section. I like the cream pop at the frozen section. They do have Ahi tuna grade fillet. It good for seared or sushi. 

Daily product includes clothing, sport items, electronic, art and craft, bicycle, jewelry, and more. I like the most is their eye glass center, you can get good pair of glass with lesser price with insurance cover. The pant and shock is my frequent item. 

The pharmacy has the beauty product I need, it also has my daily care product like tooth paste, shampoo and mouthwash. Well. They are definitely very convenient for me.

This all you can eat sushi place is a lot better than the one they have in Carrollwood. Tastes, ingredients preparation, mix of rice are better. I would said lunch has the best value here. 

We arrive on the early and seating is not a problem at week end. Through out the meal time, we still can see some seating is available on lunch. 

We have order the spicy tuna, rainbow, saki, Mexican rolls. The sushi includes escolar, surf clam, salmon. We also order some items from habachi and stir fried. 

The roll I like is the Fuji roll. It has spicy tuna and top with salmon and drizzle with eel sauce. The steak and shrimp hibachi is my favorite on the cook side. I also like the appetizer as Gyoza and the dessert with fried banana with chocolate dip. 

Overall the service is great. The food is attractive. The serving speed is acceptable.

This is USF students hang out location. The bar has pool table and dart games. The pub is lively at weekend compare to weekdays. At weekdays is divey. However, they have killer wings. 

If you come to this bar, try their wings. Many of the Tampa Bay Area wings are deep fried and sauce. I really don't like that way to prepare the wings. I prefer you either add a step like grilled it, marinated over night or breaded with flavor coating. This restaurant take a step further, the wings are marinated, slow smoke then baked per the menu. I think they at lease marinated with dry coating. I like their wings. Please try my favorite Parmesan and lemon pepper. You might want to look at their daily special combination that will save you some money including a game of pool. 

The place has some draft beer dispensers on the left of counter that is not visible. So, please look for all local draft before order. The place is three stars base in ambient and furniture. The wing is five stars. I would say this is a 3.5 stars place. I am giving them 4 stars since there is no half star.

Before catching the flight, we like to have a catfish dinner. This restaurant locates 5 minutes from the airport. As a result you can time your meal before the flight. 

The restaurant is affordable compare to any seafood restaurant in New Orleans. We have order a dozen of raw oysters and they are only $8. It came with reddish and cocktail sauce. The oysters are fresh and big. 

The main course is the blacken catfish with Creole sauce with rice.  The catfish in New Orleans is great no matter which restaurant we went to. This restaurant also has the good catfish. I like the Creole sauce with smaller size shrimp in tomato base sauce. 

The second dish is grilled tuna skew over rice Creole sauce. The tuna is assembling in the skew along with shrimp, onion, and bell pepper. The tuna is lightly season and grilled open flame. The shrimp along the skew is not as fresh as the tuna. The dish presentation is impressive with skew bridge over the Creole rice. 

The service is good. The restaurant may need to renovate to newer furniture. I saw a lot of the local eat here due to good pricing.

Tonight is happy night to see my pal. Over the weekend I was able to meet up with Anna. But today I am meeting with three yelpiest friends to try the 7 course beef dish from my last review. 

I have seven beef dishes on other Vietnamese restaurant before. The first course is the raw slice beef in the vinegar onion broil. Then beef is wrapping in rice paper with veggie. The sauce inside the wrap can be hoisin sauce and dip it on the fish sauce.

The second course is herb marinated slice beef to be cooked in butter. Then it is wrapping with rice paper with vermicelli. The third course is the slice beef in peanut. The first three courses require some work to wrap it. Some is skill with the wrap. The trick is not to over fill with material. 

The fourth course is the ground beef in tea leave. The ground beef is marinated then grill on the frying pan. The fifth course is the beef balls with shrimp chip. The beef ball is cook with clear vermicelli. This ball can be break into pieces and pickup with the shrimp chip. With the crispy of the shrimp chip and ground beef, it create the sensation of the crispy and meat flavor. The sixth course is the Sherrard beef with porridge. It top with some fried onion and the parsley. By mixing it provide some mixture of the flavor. The seventh course is the slice pork on the outwardly roll around the raw green onion. The slice beef is marinated and grilled outwardly. This course can be improved if they caramel the onion first before the slice beefs rolling will be better. It will take away the onion spiciness. 

Overall the food is good but challenge. It is a good meal to have when your group likes to have the long and good conversation. It will take time to finish. The two people for the seven courses are $35 and the 3 people are $45.

This is a restaurant when I travel and having coworker or boss with me. Chain restaurant is an easy obvious choice for the agreement of the selection. We were here for lunch and it is Wednesday. 

Wednesday in any outback have special in their menu. I have tried their $12 three course menu. The first course is the Caesar salad. The lettuce is fresh and crispy. My entree is the glaze grilled pork tenderloin with a size. I have chosen the grilled asparagus as my side and I have added an up charge item shrimp in the Barbie. The pork was grilled wonderfully with tender meat. Each cut of the pork has preserved their juice in each piece. The shrimp is grilled and maintain the size of the shrimp. Seasoning is well prepared in this case. The tomatoes are cut to half and well cook for mouth watering enjoyment. The asparagus is not dry after grilling.  Good technique. 

The third course is the carrot cake. The sweetness is well mix that not loses the ingredient taste of the carrot. This is the restaurant that I have repeated when I am go to Bartow or Orlando and need the meal before meeting. Wednesday is always the best day since they have good deal for the three courses or four courses.

This restaurant is recommended by my client. He grew up from Puerto Rico and he has indicated the food is close to his mom cooking. The Spanish music play in the background with lively atmosphere. 

This the first time I try Puerto Rican restaurant in USA. I have Puerto Rico cuisine at Puerto Rico before. I can said the restaurant at La Casona has interesting Puerto Rican menu. It include traditional Mofongo. Mofongo is a fried plantain-based dish from Puerto Rico. It is typically made with fried green plantains mashed together in a with broth, garlic, bit fried pork belly. It can be filled with vegetable, meat or seafood. This restaurant open since 1999. It have Spanish base customer. 

Today we have the seafood Mofongo and churrasco. The seafood Mofongo came with half of the lobster tail, shrimp, salty fish, muscle.  I was impress of my Mofongo serve with a bit wine base seafood broth. When you bite the olive they have cook with it, the wine juice came out and it is tasty and left wine fragrant in the mouth. This normally different than the Wikipedia description to prepare it. The broth base mix with the fried green plantain neutralize the salty of the broth. The two materials balance each other is the beauty of cooking. Good chef skill. The churrasco is ok. It can be better. Churrasco is Argentina food. Most of the time the Cuban restaurant prepare this dish better than anyone in Miami. You have choice with rice and bean or salad and sweet plantain. 

The service is good and friendly. However, the close out and bring the check is slow. This restaurant customer tender to speak louder due the natural of the Spanish customer. Food is good portion. Most of time you will have enough to take home for the remained meal.

September 11, 2001 I was at Miami working in the office before I move to Tampa. It was normal working day for a structural engineer. My coworkers rush in and said the World Trade Center has an explosion. We all went to conference room where the TV was showing the incident. That was about 9:00 am the news was broadcasting. We were wonder why. 

At 9:03 am another plane drove into south tower and create big ball of explosion. Now we know our country is under terrorist attack. At that day we all are heavy heart to watch the news of this incident. 

I has seen some people jump off the window due to no exit below the damage floor and smoke and fire below floor. Later the south tower falling. There is smoke all over the place. And many people has lost their live including the emergency responders. White dust everywhere and cover the whole City of New York. The north tower was fallen following that. 

There were 4 planes hijack that day. One to the pentagon and the other fall into the ground with the awareness of passengers fight with terrorist. 

These attacks have change our nation protecting our border. It created the homeland security department to further prevent this kind of attack. The tall tower building design also changed the approach to account for explosion force. 

This memorial with a piece of World Trade Center has reminded me during that day. We owe many thanks to emergency responders including the police and fire department, hospital emergency responders, and many heros.

I am here because of Johnathan review that they really put out a good Thai Hot restaurant. There is no hold back. So if you ask for spicy, watch out. There is no American Hot.

The restaurant has good ratings. The interior is open seating hall that most efficiently for maximum seats. The owner pay attention to the customers. And the wait staff is alert enough. They have extensive menu for your choice.

We got the Drunken Noodle and the Lad Na Noodle.  The drunken noodle is a bit wet. I like it dryer. But they did a Thai Hot for me. The spicy of the chili extended to my throats. The spiciness stay at my mount at least good 7 minutes. The Lad Na noodle is crispy noodle with beef. Food is good. We also got the stuff chicken wing. This is a dish that not normally serve. This actually the best dish. Like the staffing with pork.

The gimmick sushi. I have been conveyor belt or rotation sushi in Miami 10 year ago. Now Tampa got their first rotation sushi. The seat booths are well decorated. This method is already popular in Japan. I saw quite a few when I visited Hokkaido. 

This type of food stand supposed to provide quick sushi for short lunch time or snack with no wait. Tonight we came in late at 8:30 pm. I would said come in at weekday not weekend and late or early of meal time is better. One- don't have many people. Two-easy attention from waiter. Three-most important is order the fresh items that is not there and fresh to eat. Since the time we arrive is late, the chef start not adding dish in the conveyor belt. This actually better for me that I can order the fresh items. I would suggest the same thing if you want to try this place. 

We have order the spicy tuna, blossom roll, spicy pepper calamari, masago. I like their spicy tuna since it is all tuna meat in the roll, no added cucumber to occupy the meat space.

Cute little store in Gulfport small town. It located at Beach Blvd. if you need a home deco of small pieces art, this store may be your choice.

It has very good selection of the designer lamps. They are very colorful if you like the unique lamp that cannot be found in typical furniture store, here you have plenty. 

The wall art pieces are Floridian style. They are contemporary. All this lamp and wall art are the work of the local artists.

The Shop of Wiregrass Mall offer shopping, dining, exercising, kid club, community for the people of Wesley Chapel and New Tampa. I have been there many time and enjoy every time. They have Kid area for the activity. It is great to walk at the mall by the window shopping.


This mall is very lively due to farmer market, Christmas event, spring fair, and now the Easter event. This mall has line up event to keep it sales up. You won't believe they have Yoga at the lawn, Kid Club and many other event. Please check their web site. They also have stage area for the performance and gather the community together. 

The restaurant selection also very good. I know most of my friend go there for evening walk or dog walk. They also have the bookstore with coffee and music store with lesson. If you asking for activities, they have ton of it. One thing I like the most is their paseo drive. It is almost like the Rodeo Drive. Although not fancy but very pleasant.

Mei World Pizza has pizza and something that you not imagine they have it - The Taiwanese cuisine. I was able to take picture of the whole Chinese menu for the patrons who look forward what they are cooking. They are very flexible and they can cook to your order - meaning not in the menu. 

Mei World Pizza has another name in Chinese. The beautiful food World. Which mean the great food of the world. The specialty include noodle that is home made by hand from the kitchen. These noodles are not buying from grocery store. As a result, it creates the specialty of the restaurant with the fresh made noodle. Every Saturday weekend has fresh made dumpling. They are not frozen. They will made and cook at the spot. In winter, they cure their own meat and sell it on the February, March and April.  During that time you find the cure meat food that is not in the menu. 

The secret is out. Go enjoy the beautiful bowl of soup noodle or have them cook a special cuisine for you. I will be back to try their different food.

I would said this restaurant is unique in many ways. The cuisine, the setting of the restaurant, the attention of owner make the place great to eat. There are gluten free item and grass feed beef as their advertisements of the material of the food. 

I like to mention a little about their sound system. It is front row seat to the concert. The restaurant invest a very good sound system that is pleasure to the ear. They also hide their speaker very well. Imagine they play the Star Wars music. May the force be with you. 

We have order the taste of the islands and the blacken mango salmon. The taste of the island include curry goat, Ox tail and jerk chicken. The goat is a bit heavy smell. The jerk chicken is great with the seasoning they have. The best is the Ox Tail. The Ox tail with Caribbean spice make this dish special.

The blacken salmon is prepare with Caribbean blacken spice. It is very nice. It serves over cook pineapple sauce. The fish is tasty. This dish accompanied with a side salad. The desert we have is the coconut cake. The coconut cake has layers of coconut cream. It is guilty pleasure. 

The greeting of the owner from the restaurant make this place special. The decorations is modern and it is gear up for upper class power lunch or dinner. Nice touch. Service is great and the cook is the owner wife. It is family run with attention to the details.

#700 review. Rare Ethnic food 1 - Guatemalan cuisine. 

I choose Rincon Guatemalteco to start my 700 series in yelp review. I will start my ethnic review for next several reviews. The restaurant name meaning "in the corner of Guatemala." If you like get inside of this corner, please check them out. 

The food is an authentic, special flavor, fantastic prep work, and unique. I was surprised by taste. Today we order the Tostadas de Frito. This is an appetizer. It is tostadas top with black bean paste and sprinkle with dry cheese. My wife mistaken the black bean as chocolate. You can smell the heavy fermented cheese smell before you eat. 

The tamale we have is wrap around chicken pieces. The tamale paste is different than many tamale. The taste is more to rice paste than the bean paste texture. 

We have the main dish as Carne Adobada. It is marinated pork with rice and black bean. I would describe the best black bean paste that I have. It cook with garlic and make this bean paste stand out from other black bean preparation. 

The two drink that we have are Rosa Jamaica and 
Tamarind. Rosa Jamaica is the best drink in the Bay Area. I have try many place for this drink. But this one stand out.

Please call before you go. Close on Wednesday. Tuesday close early. Weekday 9am to 6 pm. Weekend 9am to 7 pm.

Keyword: Authentic, Northern Thai, Unique 

I believe the above word define this restaurant. They are the best Thai now in my book in the Bay Area. This restaurant just open less than a month but it does have all the unique food that you will not find any where. One thing I have to warn you is their food is spicy when you have the chef select the medium hot. For me I like very hot. 

They serve street food that only can be found in the northern kingdom of Siam - Khao Soi. This is a unique dish that only this restaurant have it. The  dish include crispy and egg noodle with chicken in coconut milk curry. The chicken include the breast and chicken drumsticks. 

They also serve Pla Koong that I like. I have this dish when I am in Miami from an authentic Thai restaurant. I have try many Thai restaurant but non have come close. Now I found my favorite again. This is broil shrimps in very spicy mixed of lemony base spices. It include lemon grass and kefir lime leave. Yum. Very spicy. Love it. 

We also order the crispy duck in basil leave. The spice they use is difficult to describe. Very good dish. We order a drunken noodle. But this time the noodle is too soggy. I have this noodle at their lunch before and it is better. We also order another northern Thai  - ginger curry. It is pork shoulder in long hours braised cooking. This is a sweet dish. For the rice you can order the white rice or the sticky rice. I never thought the sticky rice go very well with curry. 

I hope all yelper make an extra mile to support new and unique restaurant. The menu is still evolving since they can cook many northern dishes of the Thai cuisine. This restaurant do not serve alcohol but they allow you BYOB. I brought my sake. Very convenient and saving.

Base on the affordable price, great food, and good service, this is considering 5 stars restaurant. 

We have yelp group enjoy our time and food here. Since we have 7 in the group, we have ordered the Family Dinner. It is a whole chicken with salad, fried yuca, and cilantro rice. The salad is fresh with vinaigrette dressing. I like the cilantro rice with spice in rice. The chicken is marinated and slowly roasted with the skin is crispy outside. We have added the tostones - the flatten fried green plantain for other member to experience the food. 

We also ordered the Cuenellis Special - Palomilla Steak with fried egg. The steak is well season and tasty, however, the steak may need to be tenderizing for better chewing. The dish also come with fried yuca, 1/4 chicken and fried sweet plantain. A lot food for affordable meal.

Rare Ethnic Food 5 - Viennese cuisine.

The food serve similar to German cuisine due to the country next to each other. We know about this restaurant when we were at a casual conversation with Michele D. husband. He mention to us this hidden location that serve a good similar German food.

We were here for their early bird special. The special is a good deal for this restaurant. They have seven items to choose from. It come with a choice of salad or soup. I have the Sauerbraten and my wife has the Pork - Weiner Schnitzel. I like me Sauerbraten. This is pork tenderloin in wine sauce. It come with red cabbage and the Spaetzle. The red cabbage is like pickle veggie. The Spaetzle is like starch short noodle. My appetizer is the tomato soup. A bit sour for me but it is good after add pepper and salt. 

The ambient is very nice. I like it old school represent the country of the cuisine. Kuku clock, bear ceramic cup, the flag.  The service is very good. I love this mom and pop shop. I will be back.

This is my special review for a single vender in the French Market. The reason that they need special attention is due to the unique food that they are prepared. If you visit the French Market, do not miss up the opportunity to try their food. Their vender stand is located at the last vender stand of the food venders at first open air structure. It is very much at the middle of two open air structures. 

They occupied three vender stands and a front open air stand. You will not miss it. The front vender stand offers the roast cone and broil peanut. They roasted their corn in the enclose smoker. Once they receive the order, they will peel off the skin and show the ear. Then they will dip the corn to the hot butter, and season with salt, parmesan cheese (yum), Cajun spice (wow). My wife loves this corn. The inner vender stand serves the deep fried corn, crab cake, gator bites, and frog leg. They also serve different type of fruit drink and icy. We were curious the deep fry corn did not turn to pop corn. The vender owner assures us it will not happen. Evidently, it does not and coated with thin cajun coating. I have concluded the deep fried corn is a boy food and the roast corn is girl food base on the preference.

We also order the home made crab cake. The surprise is not the crab cake; it is the side dish that comes with it. The deep fried kale. I have the deep fried kale at the Cool Bean restaurant in Tallahasse FL. I did not expect they are as good as the restaurant grade. The Kale is deep fried for 30 second then season. The best thing is when you put on the tongue and the kale melt like cotton candy. The vender did a very good job.

#900 Review. Rare Ethnic Food No.11

Small business with hard working people deserve to be recognized for their success. Not only for their home feel cooking but also for the very good rare items they have served.

Before we were there, we check the people who posted the review. Many people who posted has less than 2 reviews. And only 9 were posted. No elite has posted until me and my wife visit. They have been open since last November and they have not catch attention of elite Yelper. 

Little Angel (Angelito) is bringing the love of food in our area. They are Puerto Rico and Latin cuisine. We have the pork shoulder with rice and the rotisserie chicken with mofongo. Both dish is excellent. The pork marinated very well the chicken is excellent. The mofongo is the best I have taste with garlic base. The rice dish have a choice of side. Since they run out of the sweet plantain, they give me a choice of their special made salad -  ensalata guineo en escabeche. This salad I have never seen before. It is chicken gizzard with plantain. The sauce or the dressing is out of the chart. 

Other than their regular menu, they have hot deli food that are cook ready to serve only on weekend. They showcase the special salad I have mentioned above. The pig feet also in Friday only deli dish is excellent. The skin and meat fall off the bone. 

Service is excellent. Now the secret is out. Go enjoy it.

I am using this restaurant to mark my 100 review. This will be the restaurant I will likely repeat when I come back to New Orleans. This is one of my favorite restaurants in New Orleans. Each reservation or walk in is allowed for 1.5 hours dining in the prime evening by the restaurant. The restaurant offer blue music while eating. The musician is very good and talented. They can kick into high gear or take it slow like Big Easy. 

This restaurant located Marigny area. This is a hypies area. Many people around this area are care free. But the restaurant is considered a high end even though they are located in this area. We love the performance by the musician. The guitar and harmonica have their solo highlight display the talented tune. The singer also great and the song is about the daily life. 

Tonight we have order the Two Run Farms Lamb Sliders, Beer Braised Kurobuta Pork Belly, Bleu Cheese Stuffed Dates, Seared Scallops, Crab Dra Diavolo Cannolloni and Deviled Yard Egg. Most of the dishes have a choice of small or large quantity. Our first dish is the Deviled Yard Egg. The egg filling include seasoned egg yolk. It garnish with seasoned chop vege and top with deep fry broccoli flower. You will experience with crispy, sweet vege, and salty paste taste. The second dish Bleu Cheese Stuffed Dates. The Dates wrap in bacon and drizzle with sweet vanilla balsamic vinaigrette. The Bleu Cheese is stuff in the Dates and the combination allow for salty first then sweet (bacon to sweet dates). The third dish is  pork belly. This is my favorite dish in the restaurant. The pork belly is slice in rectangular cube. They pork belly is actually braise to soft the texture then slightly sear at the outside. It place on Chinese flat bread and garnish in the pickle cucumber. When you place the pork belly at your tongue, you can feel the pork belly fat actually melt away. This is actually a Chinese technique to cook the pork belly in pressure cooker and braise in slow fire. This is a dish should not miss. The fourth dish is the Crab Dra Diavolo Cannolloni. This is fresh pasta with spicy crab meat filling. It is cook with tomato sauce with caper.  The pasta is refreshing. The fifth dish is the Lamb Slider. The lamb meat is grounded and seasoned. It cooks over the open flame and top with tomato creamy sauce. The last dish is the seared scallop. The scallop is seared and serve with charizo, red lentils and bok chai. 

Overall we enjoy the great music over the meal. I have order the local brewer beer - southern pecan beer. It is great to go with the meal. The service is great. I am award this restaurant with five star to start my 3 digit review.

Big smoke house. Be prepared to wash your clothes and wash your hair after visit. The Korean BBQ smoke will stick with you. So you know what you need to wear. If you have a group that join you, they will smell like BBQ when you you hug them good bye :) 

66 QPot restaurant name if I guess it right, it mean 66 Street BBQ and Hot Pot. Nice name. It tell you what they serving before you walk in. I would said it is 4.5 stars restaurant. I also would said this may be the best money can buy for hot pot and Korean BBQ combo in Tampa Bay Area. 

Plenty of selection for the buffet. The buffet hot pot is $23, Korean BBQ is $27 and combo is $30 per person. Good meat, seafood and veggies selection. A lot fun to eat it with friends. Don't go by yourself. They have 4, 6, 8 and 10 people table. 

To eat this, you may need a bit of cooking skills. You need to broil and grilled technique. There are also plenty of sauces that you can mixed for dipping. Choose your soup base to start for hot pot. Limit three BBQ meat at a time. Once finished, you can order more. 

It is good place to pass your time. Skip dessert and salad bar first. Enjoy!

To begin my 1800 series, Sushi Sho is legit on tasting the good sushi. It is a good show on the sushi they made. I would said this restaurant is 4.5 stars in my book. Not yet 5 stars. Since no 1/2 stars,  5 stars is given.

I got the $80 nigiri omakase. I believe this is the best value of all. It is actually good to have about $5 a piece sushi for good quality ingredients. My omakase is 17 pieces and includes a appetizer and dessert. The topping is actually enhancing the taste. Since this is trade secret, I only going to tell you, the topping including citrus family sap, Perilla, scallions.

As a result, you no longer use any soy sauce that over dipping kill the fish taste. That is the art for this restaurant with some of citrus family sap, soy sauce and wasabi. This is where a great sushi chef be. 

My 17 pieces include fish from Japan, local catch and international catch. The local catch has baby amber jack, gulf shrimp. It is good to prepared to the specific pieces of good sushi. I also like the surprising piece not in the menu such as Isaki. This is a tree trunk Japanese fish.  Very interesting fish with the skin attached. 

I like the Hokkaido scallops, medai, king salmon, and big eye tuna. I also like the appetizers with big eye tuna carpaccio with special ponzu sauce. The service is good. Very attentive sinc

It is good start for the poke work. They are ready on first day. The entire crew able to serve customers at the first day. Method and ingredients are correct. Pokeworks located at the mall near the food court. 

I did take advantage on their grand opening special but one get one free. We have free samples of the sorbet ice while we wait on the line. I like their choices on the base, ingredients, topping. It give you adjustment for not too sweet or salty of your food. Great choice. I am a fan for this poke. Many other poke store need to learn from them.

Yes. Small event but it attracts a lot peoples. I like to be there early to see the preparation of the fruit. I am helping the store to set up so I can try some of their tropical fruit. The event takes place at Jene's Tropical Fruit Trees. 

They sell fruit tree, flowering plant and more. I start the day trying the Caribbean dip. I start with the spiciest to sweet section to cool the fire in my mouth. I have chutney that prepared by the store. They have the papaya chutney is good for a sip. The mango crisp has the crispy to over it is very good. People are friendly and I like small event like this to showcase. I bought some limited amount fruit like Mamei and Nam Toc Mai.

Great bakery at the Hillsborough Ave and Sheldon. This bakery is kind hidden at the corner and very difficult to find. It is on the south east corner or the plaza. It has an outdoor red umbrella and Columbia flag in front of the store. 

If you are here, got to try their ice coffee. They use whole milk or 2% milk to stir up with mocha coffee. It use food processor to grind the ice and coffee and milk. Very delicious. 

The pastry is another best. Got to try their sweet corn and cheese item. The pastry includes beef and chicken fluffy pastry. Other than it. It has many pastry to select. Some thing sweet or salty. 

Price are affordable. Many Columbian has done here. The store server know a little English only. So point you finger. Don't worry about price. You will love and they are affordable.

I have seen one of the elite member friend review this restaurant and want to come here to check it out. The restaurant is far away from any interstate. However, it is worth a trip for taste and unique of the food. 

This restaurant only has three elite members review including me. This restaurant needs to make know. I would say this is a very creative on taste and combination of the ingredient. 

We have Ahi Poke, Out of Control Roll, Tampa Roll, and Spicy Tuna Roll. The Ahi Poke is Ahi tuna seared with shichimi pepper and tossed w. hot sesame oil, sriracha sauce, scallions, and masago. Served on crispy wonton chips, and avocado. It is a bit spicy but the preparation of the roll requires time in cooking, chopping, assembling, and decorating. It top with eel sauce and set on the fried wonton skin and make a beautiful presentation. 

The out of control roll is never out of control. The flavor is well control and sophisticate. This roll require dear across the roll top with eel sauce and masago. This is another creation of the chef. 

I would recommend order from the Uchi special roll section if you are here. The service is good. This place is a bit pricy but worth the money to try special roll.

Authentic cuisine number 59. Philippine cuisine. 

This restaurant is close to low side of 4.5 stars. I see many potential potential for this restaurant. They have many good things going on this food truck. I round them to 5 stars. 

If you come here, you got to try their halo halo. Their halo halo is different than most Philippino cuisine. The bean and jelly are home made. The juice is jackfruit juice. Very special. Best halo halo in town. 

This food truck is popular here. A lot of customers. They do have the seating area. But I rather take it to go during pandemic. The menu changes every day. When they sold out they will not continue make it until next day. 

We got the Bistek. It is sirloin beef steak simmering in soy sauce. The serve with rice and lumpia. I would only give them an average on this dish. The second dish is much better choice. It is the sautéed mung bean. It serve with the fried scad fish. The bean is one of the kind. I would recommend this dish. Fish is good. You have to chose tail or head section.

I like Nam Viet for several reasons, they have good grilled pork and boba tea. The restaurant is 4.5 stars for reasonable pricing. I would said it is recommended. 

The restaurant has side boba Machi drink. I have the Monster, Red Guava Jasmine, and the Delicious drink. All drink are delicious. The Monster is with sweet brown sugar boba. The cream milk on top, and the wall of the cup is plaster with brown sugar. It is very traditional Taiwanese preparation. I highly recommend this drink. The red guava has the different  jelly include noddle jelly andd basil seed. The "Delicious" is boba and red bean. All drinks are amazing. 

We have the caramel fish. Good garlic shrimp in clay pot. My wife have Banh Canh Thap Cam. It has combination meat including pig liver. I have the seafood Hu Tieu, this dish just ok. I like the appetizers with sugar came shrimp fresh roll. I also like the the item we have to go. The grilled pork is delicious and good BBQ.

I am glad they finally think about northern Tampa. Zoe's new location definitely will bring a lot revenue to the company. Because Dale Mabry Carrollwood area is definitely a restaurant pocket. With that said, I think will be a good contributor to the community with great food with easy selection. 

I like the new restaurant with outside seating that allow many dog owners gladly visit the restaurant. This is a plus in many way just by sacrificing a few parking space with outside seating. 

The restaurant Mediterranean cuisine has a lot to offer. You can have kabob, bowl, sandwich, pita, salad, and piadinas. We got the salmon bowl with Mediterranean Salad Trio. I am good with that. The best is salmon kabob with roasted veggies and quinoa. This is very good dish. The salmon is fresh and grilled very well. I like roasted veggies with a lot flavor. I would go for double roasted veggies incomparable to quinoa. 

The manager did make around our table to see how is our food. I also like to suggest the Mediterranean Lamb Kafka as starter if you happen to visit them.

They actually do not have the buffet. We were there thinking they have the buffet. But they have the tali plate. Which is better to my opinion. 

We got the meat tali. It has a lot of chamber to fill the plate. I like it because the appetizers also meat. My two entrees is the mutton curry and the fish curry. These two curry were very good. Especially the mutton curry Kat fresh out the kitchen. Tasty. I also like the fried chicken curry. It has a lot character. The rice has biryanis rice and good chicken in it. 

Not much of service. When yo finish the plate, they ask you dump it your self. By food is excellent.

Yelping No. 2500.

This place includes eatery and food market. I like the concept. The only down side is not much of seating area. Very limited due to space fill with groceries items. 

I got the Asian fusion bowl with grilled salmon. The salmon was excellent. The sauce in the bowl is tasty. I like mixture of ingredients. My wife got the building your own bowl with BBQ chicken and pull chicken. She like her bowl. She like the Brussels sprouts. We also got meat pie. I recommend you get that if they have it. We also got the cheese cake. They have many selections of cheese cake. The cheese taste light which is the way I love.

Krewe of Chewbacchus is one of the most unique parades for the Mardi Gras. This is the one that I like the most. This parade took place at the eastside of the out skirt of the French Quarter. This side of the town is more hypies and biker look. 

The parade theme is Intergalactic hero Chewbacchus in the Star Wars movie. It is about intergalactic movie series. The parade people dress like the character of the movie. You almost can say you are in the star war convention. This is an up close parade. You will be at an arm length from the parade. Before the parade, people are party at the street of the intersection of Frenchmen and Decatur Street. There are ladies walk by selling shot of alcohol in tube or Jell-O.  

When the parade start, People are pushing each other try to get to front to watch the parade. This parade is making up from the local people using the card board cut out and make into the shape. The floats are bicycle, golf cart, dune buggy, or man power push cart. The parade people dresses in character in Star War are Captain Han Solo, Luke Skywalker, a lot of Princess Leia, Dark Vader, Obi One Kenobi. The other movie themes are Star Trek, Guardian of the Galaxy, Super Mario, E.T., How to Train the Dragon, Zombies the Living Dead, Ghost Buster.........

Data in the Star Trek look real as the movie. This will please a lot of Treky. The Zombie is Kid friendly scary. Princess Leia has shown the two hair round bundles that is cute like movie. I cannot say enough, please experience yourself. Be prepare the crowd will get excited and push from behind. This is not a bead route but occasionally they give up the bead like items. If you want to avoid the crowd, please stand at the quarter point of the route. However, the most action is at the intersection of Decatur and Frenchmen Street. Please be early in that intersection for the front row.

My boyfriend and I went here a while ago and it was a disaster.

First of all, one of the fries for one of the meals weren't ready, so of course we had to pull up and wait for the other fries to be cooked.  But, of course, while we wait, our food (and the other order of fries) is cooling rapidly.  Finally, We get our fries and go home.

Well, sure enough not only is one order of fries ICE cold, but they completely messed up our order.  The burgers only had SOME of the stuff that was supposed to be on them!  What were we supposed to do at this point??  Get in the car and go back over there??  Yeah, right.

My boyfriend tried to contact the company (as they tell you to do) through the website, but of course, he never heard back.  I'm not really a fan of Wendy's at all, but this experience guaranteed that I will not be returning.

Dear Mr. McKinley Eastman,
  I suppose you saw it appropriate to confront me yesterday about my previous yelp review and call it "racist".  I sense that you thought that I didn't note the sarcasm in your voice when you presented your business card (after calling my review racist) and asked me if there was anything you could do to change the rating from the two stars I previously gave your establishment.  I have a suggestion for you: don't approach someone who has reviewed your business on yelp and confront them about their low rating in such a negative way.  Really.  

I arranged a yelp meet up at your restaurant before the Lundi Gras parades (you sought me out, no doubt, because I was wearing Yelp gear).  When you confronted me, other yelpers witnessed it.  Who do you think looks bad?  You got it.  Instead of politely asking about the issues I had with your place, you were immediately defensive.  Not cool. 

I won't be returning to your restaurant.  Nor will my friends.  I'm sure you don't care, you do enough business on Cinco de Mayo and Thanksgiving, right?  Maybe that's the problem.  You are obviously more concerned with making money than providing a quality product.  That's fine.  Good luck.  It doesn't mean I have to support you...Mr. Eastman.

P.S.  Please note that I am not the only patron unimpressed with your establishment.

Well, I would tell you how this place is, but I have no idea.

We stopped in hoping to get a drink and a bite to eat (it's attached to New York pizza). There was no bartender and when someone came in from the connected restaurant to make a drink, he explained that he wasn't the bartender and couldn't serve us. Uh...ok.

We waited and waited and nothing happened, so we left. Swing and a miss. Maybe next time, but I doubt there will be a next time.

No go cups and rude staff makes for a sad Marielle. 

Seriously the muscle men at this place were gross and the staff was beyond rude. I asked for a go cup and I was told that they weren't allowed on this block. This is the same block as Lucy's and Vic's. I can't take my drink to go? Come on.  

The music is what I would I imagine my suicide soundtrack would be. Seriously. It's boom boom boom with no end. Good Lawd.  If I had to pick an afterlife torture for my enemies, it would be Ohm. In conclusion, this place sucks and the people know it because I told them. I said, "Hey, do you know what Yelp is?" The dude at the door said, "Yep!" and I smiled. Here's the review you deserve. 

Good morning. Good afternoon. And Good Night! Oy.

The worst! You go and order and ask them specifically to not include certain condiments- they don't listen. Then they tell you there is going be a wait for you to get your food. They ask you to back up your car, because there is a pressure plate at the drive thru window that is timing how fast they get the food to you. When you back up, it resets. Apparently the manager doesn't like them to take longer than a minute on each customer, so their solution is to cheat the system by telling customers to roll off of the pressure plate.

Also, their highway sign is never on and lit up and I complained about it to HQ months ago . I think the employees leave it off because they don't want to be bothered with serving customers at night. It's easier to make people think you're closed.

Shady sneaks who don't deserve your business.

I don't review fast food places on here unless the food/service is exceptionally good or exceptionally bad.  This review is because this Bell is the latter.

I went here when it first opened a few months ago.  The service was super slow and the food was sub par.  I ordered a grilled stuft burrito and it was missing things that I remember being in it.  Sure, it was the first one I had had in ages, but they wouldn't just remove things from it, right?

Last weekend, it was late, so my boyfriend suggested we get Taco Bell.  First, for him to even suggest we get food from here is earth stopping, as he hates the place.  But I digress...

I ordered the Nachos Bell Grande and he got some sort of melt and a burrito.  My Nachos were DISGUSTING.  They had no "meat" (see the latest news about this place) on them and they were SOAKED in their cheese sauce stuff.  It was like someone emptied the cheese gun on it and threw in some beans.  I couldn't even finish it.  Gross!  My boyfriend took one bite of his burrito and said that it tasted awful and couldn't eat it.

I've never had any issue with any other Taco Bell.  I would chalk it up to the place just opening, and them still getting their "stride", but it's been a few months and how hard is it to make nachos??  I think I'll just go to the one on Manhattan, as I usually do.

Um. No. I don't like parades where the Krewe is more concerned with getting drunk than throwing beads. Tonight we encountered float after float of people literally just waving to the crowd and not doing anything else. It was sad. There were pretty much zero throws from this parade and the riders were obviously only there to drink and throw stuff to their friends. Skip it.

Hey kids!  Do you want your teeth vibrated out of your head by music that is super loud?  Do you want to dance in near darkness with sweaty strangers on drugs to repetitive, pulsating beats?  Do you want to over pay for a weak vodka drink?  Do you want to be hit on by a 50-something year old man who is just too cool to stay out of the club on a Saturday night (he is SO HIP!)?  Do you just have nothing else to do come 4 in the morning and you want to make one more bad decision?  Then Ampersand or "Amps" is the place for you!

Ugh.  Seriously.  It's New Orleans.  Why are you in a horrible nightclub that wishes it was in Las Vegas?  Go see some jazz, for goodness sake.  I haven't been here in over two years.  I will never go back.  You can't make me.

There was a time when Bourbon St. was a host to glittery Burlesque shows and jazz bands and culture.  Those days are long gone.  

Now Bourbon St. is nothing more than tacky souvenir shops, strip clubs and cheap drink bars.  It's basically where any kind of New Orleans culture goes to die and end up slapped on a tshirt.  It gets way too packed with people who are just there for cheap beer specials and terrible cover bands.

I guess this is a "must" for any New Orleans first timer, but go during the day and only go once.  There is really nothing redeeming about the place.

Oh, and whenever you see moisture on the street, ask yourself, "Did it rain today?".

This used to be my favorite "chain" restaurant in the city and I still love their corn grits, and would go back any day and just eat those.

Unfortunately, I am sorry to report that the last two times I ate here I got sick.  Yes, SICK.  Both times I ordered the trout Lafite (my favorite).  I thought the first time was a fluke and I was just coming down with something, but when I returned about 6 months later and ate the same thing, once again, I got sick.  It was terrible.

I have never had this issue at the Westbank or Elmwood locations, just this one.  It's sad, because I like supporting uptown businesses, but I will never go to this Zea's again.

Daaaaaaaaaaang Big Cheezy, I am straight up embarrassed right now. After loving The Juice we tried at the FQF, and raving about the Broad St. spot to the guy I'm seeing, we stopped in tonight for some take out and it did not go well.

We came in a little before 7 and there was a good crowd. We made our way to the ordering area and we were told the wait would be 20 minutes for our food- cool. We took a seat and waited and waited and waited. People came, ordered, got their food and still we waited. We only ordered two sandwiches and fries, so what was the hold up? Finally, a guy working there noticed we had been waiting a while and asked what we had ordered. We told him and then we waited some more. FINALLY after more than an hour of waiting (no kidding), we were given our food with barely an apology. We pretty much concluded that they had lost our order somewhere along the line.

Once we got the food home and actually ate it, I was pretty unimpressed. My crawgator had obviously just been quickly thrown together and the fries weren't all that great either. The only reason it was any good is probably because I was starving. This is such a bummer because I love the Broad St. location and I really talked this place up. I won't be back.

Stopped in here in an effort to soak up a bit of the "atmosphere" before it "ain't dere no more".

On a Sunday afternoon after the Irish-Italian parade it was pretty dead except for a few customers. We were quickly served by a nice woman. Ordered a couple of coffees. They were okay, but had an odd aftertaste and left a weird residue inside the cup. Maybe the coffee was old? Maybe the milk was old? I don't know, but something was off.

Probably wouldn't return. I can understand the charm of the old place, but I don't think that this Morning Call has the same pizzazz that it once held.

Parrot Pete's is a strange place.  

I met a friend here for some dessert.  First of all, this place is in the "Royal Palm" complex, which already makes it a trick to find.  Once I got there, I noticed that the place is HUGE and there was no one in there.  Like...really.. no one except for the people working there.  It was DEAD at 6 in the afternoon.  I know they serve breakfast, so maybe they get a lot of people for that.  Anyway, they serve ice cream and pastries all day.  I got a "one scoop" ice cream and my friend got a small coffee and a cake.  This came to 10 bucks.

I noticed that the average price of a piece of cake here is about 6 bucks, which just seems way overpriced for a place on the Westbank (and not even one of the nicer parts of the Westbank).

The decor inside and out is just tacky.  This has nothing to do with my rating, but it's worth mentioning.  Huge ice cream statues inside, parrot paintings, parrot statues outside, aluminum furniture outside, wicker benches, random statues of turtles and kids and dogs and palm trees with rope lights wrapped around them.  It was just such a cluster of random things that my friend quipped that the place must have been decorated by a schizophrenic.

I probably wouldn't go back to this place unless I had a really good reason.  It's just a little overpriced.  I'd be happy to pay 7 bucks for a cake at sucre, but not here.

Well, we went here with good intentions.

I love my fried pickles and I was having a craving when a friend of mine and I decided to stop in here and score some. I had never been, but I knew that they had them on the menu. So, we go in and order, they give us our number, we sit down and we wait. And wait. And wait. Over 30 minutes of waiting, to be exact. Finally someone came over and informed us that out order had been over looked and there were getting on the issue immediately. They gave us a $5 coupon to make up for it, but when you are in a hurry to get somewhere, it's too little too late.

Two stars because after all that the fried pickles were really good and fresh and, of course, fresh out of the fryer. I'm going to go back and try a burger here, I just hope that it doesn't take me over 30 minutes to get my food.

That's it. This is the last time I take Beyoncé's advice on where to eat. I know I've said it before, but I mean it this time. Look, I knew better, but I had the bright idea to get takeout from Red Lobster. Why, when there are so many better, locally owned seafood places in this town? Well, I don't have a good answer. I thought this would be a good idea; it wasn't.

I got takeout from here last week and looking over the menu, it all actually sounded good. I got the crab linguini alfredo, since I thought it would be kind of hard to mess that up. It came with a side salad that was actually really good and a pleasant surprise. The pasta on the other hand...no. When I get takeout, I usually eat half and happily save the rest for later. Y'ALL. I took a few bites, got up and threw the rest in the trash. I never throw food away, but I had to make an exception this time. The overall taste of the pasta was non existent, which was shocking considering it was doused in cream sauce. The crab tasted distinctly fishy to the point that I was afraid that if I kept eating it I would get sick. I wasn't expecting gourmet pasta, but I was expecting something better than what I got. I read Emily M's review the night before I made this decision and I still went through with it. Next time I am just going to follow my instincts.

I'm giving two stars because I enjoyed the salad and service was friendly.

#prayformoe

I am so disappointed, y'all! I struggled with this rating and I so badly wanted to give this place 3 stars, but I just couldn't do it.

When I heard we were getting a Moe's on the Westbank, I was excited. I knew that it was a Felipe's/Chipotle type of place where you could go in and order tacos and burritos and get them made fresh to order, like a Mexican subway.

We went in on a Friday night and the place was dead. Maybe it was the holiday- nope, scratch that. The dude working there said that the place is always dead: not a good sign. I stepped up and ordered a taco salad with pork and all the fixin's. First of all, the guy making the salad started with filling the salad shell with a huge fist full of lettuce. This salad was 90% lettuce. Then all of the other stuff was placed on top. There was barely any pork on this thing. I was super disappointed.

On top of that, I got queso on the side and that was an extra three bucks. Granted, they give you a huge tub of it, but I'd be happy with a little solo cup that costs a dollar.

The chips and salsa is free and that's pretty much the only good thing I can say about my experience here.

I most likely won't be back.

Every time I go to this place, I feel like I'm going to get stabbed (and I'm pretty adventurous).

I went here a lot before Katrina, so last summer when a friend's band was playing here, I jumped at the chance to check it out.  The place is smoky and gross.  A complete "guy" place, complete with pool tables.  Horrible for bands now.  The sound system just sucks.  I saw bands here all the time, Pre-K, now something is just off.  

There was only one bartender for the whole place full of people, so you had to wait forever to get service.  

I know people will say that places like this are what make NOLA unique.  Uh uh.  Places like "Lafitte's" make NOLA unique.  This is just a scummy hole in the wall.

Trust me, I am NOT a prissy snob who can't have a good time in a dive.  This place is just BEYOND.  I just thank goodness I didn't have to go to the bathroom while I was here, or I might not have made it out with my sanity.  ;)

Superior Grill is one of the places you go to because someone brings you.  The margaritas are great, but the food is just mediocre.  

If you are a fan of good Mexican food, you will leave disappointed because this place is nothing special.  I know this might sound weird, but I would describe it as "Mexican food geared towards white people", only because the few times I have eaten here the food has lacked flavor.  I think they are more concerned with keeping their uptown St. Charles Ave. clientele happy than spicing up the meals.

The margaritas are fantastic!  I usually like to go and hang out on the patio with friends and just have a few drinks and maybe an app.  It's nice to sit outside during the nice months when the weather is pretty.  BUT, it's not really worth fighting the crowds for this one experience.

This is it. Today was the day that I gave Starbucks one more chance and they failed me. I really never buy iced coffee anymore. David gave me a very nice coffee maker, so I can make iced coffee at home, but I was in a pinch today so I thought I would stop in here and grab a quick cup. Big mistake. Huge. 

Time and time again they fill the entire cup with big chunks of ice and then put in the coffee. The result is a cup of coffee that I finish before the ice even melts. My grande was probably a quarter cup of actual coffee. Last time I asked them not to do this and they did it anyway. This time I totally forgot to mention it, but I feel as if it's common sense. 

Just for the record: I don't blame the employees- I know they are only doing as instructed. I blame Starbucks HQ for being stingy with their coffee. As much as they are charging, they should be willing to be a little more accommodating.

Um yeah. I have now eaten here and I can say with full certainty that this place sucks. We ordered the burger medium and naturally it came medium well. This is irritating mainly because I only eat red meat once a week, so this was my one shot and it  was terrible.

Before the burger, we got the egg roll appetizer. It was okay. I mean, it was as decent as deep fried frozen egg rolls can be. The beer? The beer was a "no" and had ZERO flavor. To refer to this place as a "brewery" is a joke. All of the beer tastes the same and just makes me sad.

Coyote Ugly is not only a downtown bar, it's a chain bar and that might be the worst of the worst.

Look, I get it, a place like this isn't interested in appealing to the local crowd. They are just hoping to attract enough tourist foot traffic to keep the doors open. I totally get it. The people who work here are super nice and welcoming. If you think your experience here is going to be anything like the movie that shares it's name, you are going to be sorely disappointed.

Not once did anyone say to me, "Hell no, H2O!" Pfft!

Ugh.  Is there anything appealing about the Gold Mine once you leave the cloud of college?  

First of all, why is there a cover?  Why are they charging 3 bucks to go into a bar that is a smidge larger than a one bedroom apartment, hot as I don't know what, in the summer and has an actual line to get their signature drink...a flaming dr. pepper, is it?  Uhh...yeah.

I can't remember the last time I set foot in this joint, but what I always tell people is that it's not that type of place you set out to go to, it's the kind of place at which you just end up, for whatever reason.

If you are in college or out at 2 am in the quarter, go for it.  Otherwise, just cut your losses and call it a night.

This is a rare "unlisted" review.  It doesn't even deserve one of my cool lists!!

I don't know what it is about this PJs.  Whenever I'm in mid city (which is pretty rare these days) I usually find myself here and I am usually left disappointed.  It seems as if they are consistently out of 2% and whole milk (shouldn't whole milk be a staple in a coffee shop?  Kinda like...cups?) and they only offer half and half or soy milk, instead.  Soy milk?  In iced coffee?  Yeah, I'll take your word for it.  I get the half and half, and it usually dilutes the whole flavor of the coffee, even if I just get a little.

I do like the croissants, as they are usually pretty fresh, but compared to other PJs, the iced coffee here just isn't to my liking.

Jen L's review reminded me that I had never reviewed this bar built on bad decisions and broken dreams.

Most dive bars aren't too bad. Most dive bars have their selling points. Brothers 3 has two good jukeboxes. Henry's has a surprisingly good beer selection. Snake and Jake's has...a dark dank bar and a sofa that might give you ebola.

Maybe it's because I wasn't a Tulane or Loyola kid, but I didn't discover Snake and Jake's until my late 20's. By then, my eyes had opened onto the reality of what this place really is and any charm that I would have found here was long gone.

The people are nice enough but it's so dark. I like a dark bar, but it's so dark here that I feel uncomfortable. Is that part of the charm? Hey, whatever floats your boat. And the bathrooms. Ohhhhh the bathrooms. They are pretty much pitch dark, which can only be a blessing. God only knows what it looks like in the light.

The biggest problem that I've encountered here is by the time people get here, the night is over. It's done. You don't need to be drinking anymore, you need to be at home sleeping. People tend to be obnoxious and start waving their cigarettes around in tight quarters. That's another thing- the smoke. The point is nearly moot, but the ventilation in this joint is non existent. Really, the smoking ban will only help this place. 

It's one of those places you want to visit at least once, just to say you did. Go once. Have a beer, watch out for flailing cigarettes, don't use the bathroom and, for the love of God, do NOT sit on that sofa.

I'm going to just lay it on the line: the bar is cool, but the drinks are overpriced. Way overpriced. $8 for a beer you can get for $5 elsewhere overpriced. Look, I'm not a dope. It's the Quarter. You're gonna charge what dumb tourists are gonna pay. Can I show you my Louisiana ID and get a discount? Even if it's just a buck off? Seriously, we are on the same team here. We're all friends. $15 for two beers is a little much. It's water and barley...don't get arrogant.

Other than that, this place is cool. Cool people and cool staff. Just don't rob me.

Oh, Ross, you are an enigma wrapped in a riddle wrapped in a mess.

Let's start with the good.  You carry all kind of clothes, but specifically, the dresses you carry are great.  I can find anything here, from casual to dressy and for a really great price.  There are dresses here from the same brand as dresses I have seen at Dillard's (for a lot more money).  I love to come here and look for a nice sundress, when I need one for a summer party and the ones I have have become boring.

Now, the bad.  Oh, Ross.  Why do you have only one register open out of seven?  Don't you see the super long line this creates?  Don't you realize that most times I don't visit you, because the length of time I stand in line isn't worth the money I will be saving by patronizing you?  I mean, there are TWO greeters at the door.  Couldn't one of those ladies be working another register?  Certainly they have more skill than just saying, "Welcome to Ross!" when I walk in. 

Also, your aisles are super narrow and your shopping carts are super wide.  I understand that you are pressed for space, but a few inches would make a world of difference.  Also, wouldn't it make sense for customers to NOT push their wide carts down the aisles, thus blocking anyone else who would like to shop in said aisle, but can't, because it would be a squeeze?  I thought this was common sense, but here we are. 

Last but not least, all of the sizes are mixed up.  You have 2's mingling with 12's and 6's cavorting with 10's.  There's no rhyme or reason to this.  That's one thing if I'm at a thrift store, but Ross, you aren't a thrift store.  Don't sell yourself short.  Get organized!

Let's be honest, Ross, I am being very generous with my two stars.  You know it.  I know it.  So many simple changes could be made in order to make this store great.  PLEASE start with opening more registers.  There are people who would LOVE a job right now.  Hire more people.  

In conclusion, Ross, you have an assignment:
1) Hire more people and open more registers.
2) Expand the aisles.  More space means more shoppers!
3) Organize your selections by size!  2,4,6,8,10,12...etc.  In that order, Ross!  Don't get creative!

I don't know.  On a scale of "Sucky" to "Awesome", I think that I would rate this place a solid "Meh".

First, let me start by saying that I'm not a HUGE fan of Greek food and gyros, so if you are, you may be a better judge then me.

This place pegs itself as a coffee shop that also serves food.  I went and I got some pita and hummus as an app and a chicken gyro as my dinner.  It was ok.  Nothing special.  The hummus wasn't bad, but it's hard to screw that stuff up.  I would try it again, only because I like to try a place twice before I declare that I hate it.
